description: This file defines the React component EditorPage which functions as a post editor interface within a blogging platform. It manages state for post title, content, publishing status, and handles auto-saving, publishing, unpublishing, and deleting posts. It integrates with external APIs for data persistence and media upload, and uses React hooks for lifecycle and debouncing.

methods.name: useDebouncedCallback
methods.description: Creates a debounced function to limit the rate of invoking a callback, useful for auto-saving title/content changes.

methods.name: ensurePostId
methods.description: Ensures a post ID exists, creating a new post if necessary, and navigates to the new editor URL.

methods.name: debouncedSave
methods.description: Handles auto-saving of post title and content with a debounce delay.

methods.name: handleUploadImage
methods.description: Uploads an image file using the external uploadImage utility and returns its URL.

methods.name: handleContentChange
methods.description: Updates the local content state and triggers auto-save when the editor content changes.

methods.name: handleTitleChange
methods.description: Updates the title state and triggers auto-save when the title input changes.

methods.name: handleManualSave
methods.description: Performs an explicit save of the current post data.

methods.name: handleTogglePublish
methods.description: Toggles the published state of the post, updating slug and publishing status accordingly.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the current post after confirmation and redirects to dashboard.
